kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
From Aramaic קַנְיָא / ܩܢܝܐ (qanyā, “reed, cane, tube”), from Akkadian 𒂵𒉡𒌑𒌝 (qanûm).
Sense 2 is a semantic loan from English channel.
See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
Possibly borrowed from Ancient Greek Καινή (Kainḗ).
g: Qena (a city, the capital city of Qena governorate, Egypt)

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: تَقَنَّى • (taqannā) V (non-past يَتَقَنَّى (yataqannā), verbal noun تَقَنٍّ (taqannin))
g: to acquire, gain, obtain, appropriate, seize

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Color or defect adjective from the root ق ن و (q n w).
